title: All In MC: Configs
description: In-game config menu for all All In MC mods. Press K to browse, edit, and save settings without leaving the game.
body:
# All In MC: Configs

A unified in-game configuration menu for the All In MC mod suite.

## How it works

1. Press **K** (rebindable) to open the config menu
2. Pick any All In MC mod from the list
3. Edit its config values and save

No file editing needed. Also accessible from the **Mods menu** via the Config button.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4
- NeoForge 21.4.156+
- At least one other All In MC mod installed

---

Part of the **All In MC** mod suite by Sqersters.
